name: Park Hyatt Abu Dhabi Hotel and Villas
positioning: Park Hyatt beach resort on Saadiyat Beach, Saadiyat Island, with stand-alone villas, Camp Hyatt and access to a Gary Player golf course
best_for: Families who want Camp Hyatt and a beach resort base in Abu Dhabi
Couples or groups wanting a villa with a private plunge pool
Golfers who want to play the Saadiyat Beach Golf Course

facts.text: The hotel is on Saadiyat Beach, on Saadiyat Island in Abu Dhabi.
Camp Hyatt is a facility for younger guests with indoor and outdoor recreational activities.
At Camp Hyatt, kids ages five and above can play in supervised surroundings for free.
The resort has flood-lit tennis and padel courts.
The Cafe serves Middle Eastern specialties alongside international dishes.
The Library is a tea lounge with orange leather panels, black marble accents and an open fire feature.
Beach House Shala Lounge is a barefoot beach lounge on the shores of Saadiyat Island.
Rooms have Le Labo Bergamot 22 bath amenities.
Rooms have a private balcony or terrace with views of the Arabian Sea, the gardens or the pool.
The hotel runs a daily shuttle to Yas Island, covering Yas Waterworld, Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World and SeaWorld.
Valet parking is offered 24 hours a day to hotel guests and visitors.

highlights.text: The beach view villas are stand-alone villas with a separate bedroom, kitchen, living room and a large terrace with a private plunge pool.
Hawksbill turtles nest on Saadiyat Island, and an in-house marine biologist offers tours at specific times of the year.
Guests can play the 18-hole championship Saadiyat Beach Golf Course, designed by Gary Player.
Mate serves Argentinian cuisine with a contemporary Lebanese twist.
Beach House serves Italian cuisine influenced by recipes from the southern Italian coast, with views over Saadiyat Beach.

considerations.text: Zayed International Airport is about 30 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is located outside the central Abu Dhabi city area.
The marine biologist's turtle tours run only at specific times during the year.
